brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by wind-blown debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust as specified in SOP-015, ensuring any obstruction above one quarter of the free area is cleared before the forecast heat event. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021. The supplied documents do not cover maintenance interval compliance procedures for an ONAN cooling type with an oil issue.
